name: ibc2021
description: IBC 2021 geometric pre-check pack. ADVISORY ONLY: a geometric pre-check, not a code review - verify with a licensed professional / AHJ. Thresholds and tables encode common IBC 2021 values (data-driven so a 2024 edition swaps in), but this pack is NOT the code and never certifies compliance. Occupant-load factors are IBC Table 1004.5 gross/net areas converted to m2; exit-count bands are IBC 1006.3.2; travel distance assumes a sprinklered building.

rules.message: stair riser exceeds 7 in (0.178 m) max (IBC 1011.5.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
stair tread depth under 11 in (0.279 m) min (IBC 1011.5.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
stair headroom under 80 in (2.032 m) min (IBC 1011.3) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
stair clear width under 44 in (1.118 m) min (IBC 1011.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
corridor clear width under 44 in (1.118 m) min (IBC 1020.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
door clear width under 32 in (0.813 m) min (IBC 1010.1.1) - advisory pre-check, not a code review

walking surface more than 30 in (0.762 m) above adjacent grade - IBC 1015 requires a 42 in (1.067 m) guard; guard presence/height is name-matched only, verify by hand - advisory pre-check, not a code review
habitable-space ceiling height under 90 in (2.286 m) min (IBC 1208.2) - advisory pre-check, not a code review
computed occupant load per room (area / IBC Table 1004.5 factor); a flag means the room's occupancy has no factor - advisory pre-check, not a code review
room provides fewer exits than IBC 1006.3.2 requires for its occupant load (exits are objects named 'exit' within reach of the room; verify egress by hand) - advisory pre-check, not a code review

straight-line distance from room centroid to nearest exit exceeds 250 ft (76.2 m), the sprinklered-building limit (IBC 1017.2, Table 1017.2); this is straight-line NOT the routed path - advisory pre-check, not a code review
